	if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_state = {
				OR = {
					zin_is_site_road_salt = yes
					zin_is_site_road_gold = yes
					zin_is_site_road_rift = yes
					zin_is_site_road_lake = yes
					zin_is_site_road_sand = yes
				}
			}
		}
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					zin_is_site_road_salt = yes
					zin_is_site_road_gold = yes
					zin_is_site_road_rift = yes
					zin_is_site_road_lake = yes
					zin_is_site_road_sand = yes
				}
			}
			add_building_construction = {
				type = infrastructure
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		capital_scope = {
			add_building_construction = {
				type = infrastructure
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
